source_snapshot.procedure: Collect SDR and TEMP_MB Sensor List data through IB and OOB, then check BMC Web Sensor List.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor names, descriptions and readings in all views match the SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek queries the testcase title as a sensor name, omits IB and Web evidence, truncates SDR and exposes OOB credentials.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify all motherboard temperature sensors defined by the platform specification consistently across in-band IPMI SDR/Sensor List, out-of-band IPMI SDR/Sensor List and the BMC Web Sensor List.
original_test_intent.target: The exact motherboard sensor set selected by the source `TEMP_MB` family and owner sensor map for one verified SUT/BMC, not a literal sensor named `Sensor Check - MB`.
original_test_intent.scope: Complete IB and OOB SDR lists, complete IB and OOB sensor lists with a derived TEMP_MB subset, and BMC Web entries for every required motherboard sensor. It does not alter thresholds, create a temperature stimulus or test fan control.
original_test_intent.operation: Collect all four command views with full raw evidence, capture the corresponding Web entries, normalize only specification-defined name/description/reading/unit/status/threshold representations and produce a per-sensor cross-interface comparison.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 3 attended and 0 machine minutes. The procedure defines one collection from each interface; the zero machine-time field does not authorize omission of the four command captures.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required motherboard sensor is present and uniquely mapped; its name, description and reading are correct under the platform specification and consistent across the five views after accounting only for owner-approved UI rounding or sampling-time differences.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware and motherboard sensor-spec revision; full raw IB/OOB SDR and sensor lists with status; exact TEMP_MB derivation; Web captures; timestamps; expected and observed per-sensor mapping; normalized and raw comparison; error/missing/duplicate results; no-write/no-clear audit.
ambiguities: The authoritative motherboard sensor inventory, exact TEMP_MB names and expected values are absent.
The permitted sampling skew, UI rounding and field-equivalence rules are not defined.
The source's quoted wrapper and zero machine time do not clarify automation timing.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the title-as-sensor substitution and requires complete IB/OOB/Web evidence, specification mapping, protected credentials and no log clearing. Its main classification and scope are sound.

applicable_history.decision: V2 reclassifies DeepSeek's incomplete YES to REQUIRES and preserves all source interfaces. No later user ruling supplies the missing motherboard map or normalization policy.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2. The four command collections are machine-executable, but BMC Web evidence and final correctness need protected access, the product motherboard sensor specification and owner-approved cross-interface normalization.

available_now: The required IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web views are explicit.
Complete command Actual Values and visible Web fields can be collected before the expected matrix arrives, but cannot support PASS alone.
missing_inputs: The BMC/platform owner must supply the motherboard sensor inventory, exact names/descriptions, units/status/thresholds/readings and allowed Web/IPMI representation differences.
The lab/automation owner must supply approved ipmitool, protected IB/OOB credentials/endpoints and an operator or approved browser capture for BMC Web.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform owner supplies the sensor spec and normalization; the lab/automation owner supplies protected command/Web access.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect and hash complete raw IB/OOB SDR and sensor-list data and the current Web sensor view without clearing logs.
Derive a candidate TEMP_MB inventory while marking all unmatched or ambiguous rows and withholding a verdict.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not query `Sensor Check - MB` as a sensor ID, use grep/head output as complete evidence, expose credentials, clear logs, modify thresholds/sensors, hide cross-channel differences or declare PASS without the owner matrix.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Match the spec revision to the exact firmware, account for every required MB sensor in all five views, retain raw evidence, apply only approved rounding/sampling mappings and obtain owner disposition for every discrepancy.

revision_candidate.test_name: Motherboard Sensor Consistency Across IB, OOB and BMC Web
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify the complete platform-defined motherboard sensor set and its readings consistently across both IPMI paths and BMC Web.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server motherboard, BMC firmware and sensor schema with authorized host IPMI, protected RMCP+ and BMC Web access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every required TEMP_MB/motherboard sensor in complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List captures plus BMC Web, once per interface; no sensor stimulus or policy write.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified identities/versions; motherboard sensor spec and inventory; field/rounding/sampling equivalence rules; approved ipmitool and endpoints; secret-safe credentials; Web capture; synchronized timestamps; evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect complete IB and protected OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs, preserving stdout/stderr and status. Derive but do not substitute the TEMP_MB view. Capture all corresponding BMC Web Sensor List entries. Normalize each required sensor according to the owner map and compare name, description, reading, unit, status and defined thresholds while retaining raw values.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC/firmware verified; spec and equivalence mapping available for verdict; tools and access approved; clocks/sample window recorded; logs preserved; no concurrent firmware/sensor changes.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/spec/timestamps; complete raw four command views; derived TEMP_MB set; Web captures/export; expected-versus-observed sensor matrix; raw and normalized fields; exit/UI errors; missing/duplicate/stale rows; no-write/no-clear audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved motherboard sensor specification for this exact platform/firmware and the source requirement that SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web names, descriptions and readings match it.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only. Do not expose secrets, clear logs, truncate raw output, change thresholds or sensor policy, substitute a title string for sensor IDs, or normalize discrepancies without an approved rule.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No interactive approval is required for authorized read-only collection. Owner input is required for the specification, BMC Web evidence path, equivalence rules and final discrepancy judgment.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Automation collects and compares command views. An operator or browser harness supplies Web evidence; the BMC engineer resolves vendor-specific names, rounding, sampling and expected readings.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No functional recovery is expected. On wrong target, authentication, malformed output or sensor mismatch, preserve full evidence and stop interpretation; correct access or specification before one bounded recollection.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong target/firmware; credential exposure; incomplete/truncated data; missing Web view; ambiguous/duplicate sensor; unapproved normalization; stale/invalid reading; absent spec for verdict; BMC/thermal anomaly; or any proposed write/log clear.

identified_defects: DeepSeek uses the testcase title as a sensor name and omits source-required interfaces.
DeepSeek truncates evidence and exposes credentials.
The source lacks the sensor inventory, expected fields and cross-interface normalization.
reason_for_change: No V2 semantic change is necessary; V3 records the exact five-view evidence contract and readiness handoff without rewording a correct conclusion as an improvement.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-BMC-01031-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source explicitly requires SDR and Sensor List through both IB and OOB plus BMC Web, with TEMP_MB as the command filter and SPEC as acceptance authority.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact sensor map, expected values and interface-equivalence rules are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Distinguishes the testcase title from actual TEMP_MB sensor identifiers.
Defines raw-versus-derived evidence and all five required views.
Separates collectable Actual Values from final SPEC correctness.
resolved_blockers: Missing expected values do not prevent complete read-only Actual Value collection.
remaining_blockers: Final verdict requires the owner sensor matrix/equivalence rules and BMC Web evidence.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V2 is already correct. V3 preserves it and makes readiness ownership and the five-view/raw-evidence completion boundary explicit without adding unsupported scope.
